description: NaNbO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-3.01 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.85 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.69 Å. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-30°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.18 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-29°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.18 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-20°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.03 Å. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-24°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.14 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
